answer: Ephemeral Task Chain: identities must complete a randomized sequence of small, time-stamped verification tasks before any economic action. Like tracing water through a karst, each step depends on the last, so parallelism fails. An attacker must supply real attention across the whole chain, and idle wander between unrelated tasks breaks continuity. Cost per identity is sustained human minutes, not a one-time fee. Verify only after an orchard of dependent checks passes; clones that skip continuity forfeit the action.
